about.description: SLVON is an ETF perpetual listed on Gate, tracking iShares Silver Trust, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Gate prices this market off the Ondo tokenized stock for iShares Silver Trust, a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 75× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
